[h1]What is Pavephobia?[/h1]
Well, good question. Pavephobia is an action game where you decide how the level builds up. You choose whether you want to encounter a trap or an enemy next. It's up to you.
Collect enough money to buy useful gadgets and weapons. And last but not least, boss fights.. 
You want to know more? Then go to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2204880/Pavephobia]Pavephobia[/url]!

notes.title: UX Update
notes.content:
Thanks to all supporters and your feedback! 
I have been focusing on the [i]User Experience[/i] in this update.
[h3]Previews[/h3]
The selected building from the build menu will be shown as a preview.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520244/484385b4ebbd8324bb52b36843f412cad694e725.gif[/img]

[h3]Missing requirements[/h3]
The player is now reminded when resources are missing to build a building. Especially with villages there was a lot of confusion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39520244/3f86f4300cfd3f5997a6e0690949ceaf408e37c5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Moving resources[/b]: no option menu will open, but is moved immediately.
[*] [b]Collecting resources[/b]: no option menu will open, but is collected immediately.
[*] The icons in the pause menu are now labeled, because the icons were not clear for all players.
[*] Setting for the UI scaling is now available
[*] New players no longer start directly in the first tutorial level. Instead they start on the world map.
[*] The game starts in fullscreen mode at the current screen resolution by default.
[/list]

Have fun!
